title: Strict-local model comparison for projective-line stalk exchange
statement: For the projective-line pullback square and integral geometric points of the reduction theorem, strict henselian local rings and a local map between them, a restricted torsion sheaf, source and target stalk additive equivalences, and residue cohomology additive equivalences exist and commute with the stalk exchange and cohomology pullback maps.

source.place: proof of Theorem Tag 095T, paragraphs 3--4; strict-henselization stalk comparison

proof.text: Choose Ω=AlgebraicClosure k′ and its spectrum map ν. The compatible-residue theorem supplies A,B, their ring and strictly henselian structures, the local homomorphism, spectrum identifications with the canonical strict henselizations, and both commuting residue maps. Pull F back along the resulting jA to define F0; isTorsionSheaf_upperStar gives its torsion instance.

Apply the strict-local stalk-exchange comparison to this fixed geometric model, obtaining a1,a2 and their exchange equation. Apply the proved residue-cohomology comparison to the same F0 and commuting residue square, obtaining b1,b2 and their pullback equation.
Use the chosen rings, instances, φ and F0 as the existential witnesses. Supply a1,a2,b1,b2 and pair the two compatibility equations. Every target binder and conclusion is unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tags 03Q9 and 095T; Q1 stage-3 proof: compatible geometric model, independent stalk comparison, and residue cohomology conjugacy proved by coefficient isomorphisms and cohomology functoriality
